visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange-and-white tabby cat is nestled inside a red and white cardboard box designed with a cut-out window. The box sits on a light-colored wooden floor next to the base of a plush grey fabric sofa. A purple fleece cloth lies partly inside the box. The lighting is soft and natural indoor light. (2) The camera zooms in closer on the cat's face as it peers intently through the square window on the side of the cardboard box. The cat has large, round, dark eyes and white fur around its snout and neck. It remains mostly still, looking directly toward the camera lens. (3) The scene shifts to a view inside the box where the cat is lying on its side. It uses its front paws to rhythmically knead the purple fleece cloth, pushing and pulling its claws in a focused manner. The background inside the box is dark cardboard. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the cat's lower body and tail as it continues the rhythmic kneading. The camera then shifts back to the cat's face, which shows a look of intense concentration while its paws move vigorously against the purple fabric.
